title: Inflight rescue: idempotency rotation & serialization sentinel for tenant escalations
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Several large customers experienced repeated 5xx/timeouts during high-concurrency uploads and multi-part requests. Investigation shows a race in multipart assembly + a window where idempotency token reuse (collisions under aggressive client retries) causes duplicate inflight executions and KV cache thrashing. The result is request amplification and intermittent 5xx waves tied to tenant bursts. This ticket implements a short-term inflight stabilizer and a medium-term idempotency rotation + a serialization sentinel to stop malformed partials from poisoning the runtime.
updates: 2026-03-05 - Triage call with on-call, SRE, runtime, and account leads. Incident declared; customer-bridge opened.

2026-03-06 - Hotfix spike: prototype inflight stabilizer (per-tenant semaphore + lightweight request fingerprint) implemented in edge-proxy; added guard to refuse >N concurrent assemble workers per-tenant. Shadowed for two customers.
2026-03-07 - QA: unit tests for multiparts + simulated retry storms added. Observability: new metric tenant.inflight_assembly_count and metric idempotency.collision_count instrumented.

2026-03-09 - Canary deploy to 3 pods: observed inflight_assembly_count drop and KV eviction rate down 42% for impacted tenants; 5xx rate for canary tenants dropped from 6.9% to 0.8% in 30m window. No regression on p95 latency.
2026-03-11 - Design review: agreed medium-term plan for epoched idempotency tokens with reseed-on-lease and a server-side collision resolver for tokens older than 60s.
2026-03-12 - Prepare release: feature flag gate (feature_flags.inflight_rescue) and canary rollout script; customer comms draft shared with support and account teams.
Next: schedule full rollout to hosted region us-east-1 if canary remains stable for 48h; follow-up ticket to backport to Dedicated runtime will be created after stabilization.
implementation_notes: Hotfix component: inflight stabilizer in edge-proxy (edge/assembly_manager.go). Implements per-tenant semaphore + deterministic fingerprint (SHA256 of request-outline + short nonce) to dedupe assemble worker creation.

Idempotency rotation: server maintains a per-tenant epoch counter (epoch_id) stored in metadata KV with TTL. Client-provided idempotency keys are concatenated with epoch_id server-side before hashing so collisions across bursts are minimized.

Serialization sentinel: small guardian step in multipart reassembler that validates sequence continuity and aborts on out-of-order fragments with a 409-like sentinel error. Partial artifacts are moved to quarantined prefix for later repair instead of feeding runtime cache.
Feature flags: feature_flags.inflight_rescue.edge and feature_flags.inflight_rescue.runtime. Default disabled. Canary path enables both.
Config knobs exposed in console: tenant.max_inflight_assemblies (default 20), tenant.idempotency_epoch_ttl_seconds (default 120), sentinel.quarantine_ttl (default 3600).
Telemetry events to track: tenant.assembly.aborts, tenant.idempotency.collisions, tenant.kv.evictions, tenant.5xx.rate, tenant.latency.p95, feature_flag.rollout_state.
Graceful fallback: for VIP customers, an escape hatch routes new multipart uploads to Dedicated pool (dedicated-rescue-route) when tenant.5xx.rate > 2% for 10m.
Testing notes: add chaos test that floods retries with sticky client keepalive misuse; verify no deadlock and that inflight counts stabilize.
acceptance_criteria: Canary tenants show tenant.5xx.rate reduction to <0.5% rolling 30m compared to pre-patch baseline.
No p95 latency regression > 7% across canary in 60m window.
Idempotency.collision_count decreases by >80% for tenants that previously showed collisions.
Feature flags allow immediate kill-switch and full rollback without requiring runtime restarts.
QA sign-off on unit/integration tests covering collision windows and multipart reassembly edge cases.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: aggressive per-tenant semaphore may cause legitimate concurrency to be throttled for high-throughput customers. Mitigation: conservative default + tenant override via console and VIP escape hatch to Dedicated.

Risk: epoched idempotency increases token churn and may confuse some SDKs. Mitigation: SDK owners will be notified in migration notes; server accepts both epoched and legacy token forms for a transition period.
Risk: quarantining partial artifacts could lead to storage growth. Mitigation: sentinel.quarantine_ttl with background compactor and monitoring alert on quarantine.len > X.
Risk: bug in rotation logic could allow replay if epoch reseed not atomic. Mitigation: use CAS operations on metadata KV and add instrumentation for failed CAS attempts.
postmortem_action_items: (A) Backport stabilizer to Dedicated runtime and add a config to toggle per-deployment behavior.
(B) Create a lightweight SDK advisory that documents server epoching behavior and recommended idempotency usage patterns.
(C) Add automated alert that correlates idempotency.collision_count spikes with tenant.kv.evictions to detect similar regressions earlier.
(D) Run a quarterly chaos test that simulates retry storms across a subset of tenants.
